note: Mapping prepared by the team for this sandbox. It shows which requirement each control is designed to meet; it is not legal advice.

frameworks.title: Guiding Opinions on Regulating the Asset Management Business of Financial Institutions (PBOC, CBIRC, CSRC and SAFE, 2018)
Measures for the Suitability Management of Securities and Futures Investors (CSRC, 2016)
Internal control set by the Aegis team
Measures for Labelling AI-Generated Synthetic Content (CAC, MIIT, MPS and NRTA, 2025)
Circular to licensed corporations on the use of generative AI language models (SFC, 2024)
2026 Annual Regulatory Oversight Report: generative AI and AI agents (FINRA, 2025)

R-01.requirement: A proposal invests the whole amount exactly once, so every other check measures the real portfolio.

R-02.requirement: Asset management that uses AI must follow the general rules on investor suitability.
Match each product's risk level to the investor's risk tolerance, and do not recommend products above it.
Recommend only investments that suit the client's risk tolerance and ability to bear losses.

R-03.requirement: No single non-cash product may exceed 40% of a portfolio, so one product cannot dominate the outcome.

R-04.requirement: The suitability assessment covers the client's financial situation, including liquid assets and regular commitments.

R-05.requirement: The suitability assessment covers the client's objectives, including how long they want to hold the investment.
Under a 3-year horizon, equity and gold together stay at or below 20%.

R-06.requirement: The suitability assessment covers how long the client wants to hold the investment, so no lock-up may outlast it.

R-07.requirement: Tell clients about all costs and related charges in good time.
A weighted annual fee above 1.00% is flagged for the client to acknowledge.

R-08.requirement: Take the client's ability to bear losses into account.
Assess the investor's risk tolerance before recommending products.

R-09.requirement: Take the client's ability to bear losses into account.
Assess the investor's risk tolerance before recommending products.

ai_controls.requirement: Report the AI model's main parameters and asset-allocation logic to the regulator.
ai_controls.control: Model disclosure report (model, prompt fingerprint, tools, allocation logic and rules), exported from the Control Room.

ai_controls.requirement: Open a separate account for each investor's AI-managed investing.
ai_controls.control: Each client has a separate sandbox account; executed orders touch nothing else.

ai_controls.requirement: Make investors fully aware of the AI algorithm's inherent defects and risks.
ai_controls.control: Disclosure DISC-04 on the Confirm screen, read before every execution.

ai_controls.requirement: Follow the general rules on investor suitability and information disclosure.
ai_controls.control: The compliance gate (R-02, R-08, R-09) checks every proposal, the AI's included.

ai_controls.requirement: Do not use AI to exaggerate products or mislead investors; never promise principal or returns.
ai_controls.control: Every AI reply passes the grounding check: unsupported numbers and promise words never reach the client.

ai_controls.requirement: When model defects or system faults cause herd behaviour that threatens market stability, step in by hand to adjust or stop the AI business.
ai_controls.control: Suspend AI advisor and Halt execution switches, each with a logged reason.

ai_controls.requirement: Record events automatically over the system's lifetime.
ai_controls.control: Append-only operation log of every tool call, broker decision, gate result and order.
ai_controls.note: Applied as good practice: investment advice is not on the Act's high-risk list.

ai_controls.requirement: Let people oversee the system and stop it.
ai_controls.control: Only the client's own Confirm click places orders, and compliance can stop the advisor at any time.
ai_controls.note: Applied as good practice: investment advice is not on the Act's high-risk list.

ai_controls.requirement: Tell people they are interacting with an AI system, and mark AI-generated content in a machine-readable way.
ai_controls.control: The chat opens with an AI notice, every reply carries its label, and its provenance travels with it and in X-AI-* response headers.

ai_controls.requirement: Before the transaction, give a retail client a statement on how the advice suits them.
ai_controls.control: A hash-chained advice record holds the proposal, the gate result, the disclosures and the quiz.

ai_controls.requirement: Add explicit labels that users can see to AI-generated text, in the content or the interface.
ai_controls.control: Each reply is labelled AI-generated, Automated template (checked) or System notice where the client reads it.

ai_controls.requirement: Add implicit labels to the metadata of AI-generated content.
ai_controls.control: Each reply's provenance (label, serving model, configuration fingerprint, SHA-256 of the text) is stored with it and sent as response headers.

ai_controls.requirement: File the advisory algorithm and disclose how it works.
ai_controls.control: The model disclosure states the configuration fingerprint that every reply records, so a filing can be matched to the answers it produced.

ai_controls.requirement: Combine human oversight with AI advice.
ai_controls.control: The review queue: AI turns flagged by code are cleared or escalated by the compliance officer, and only the client's own click executes.

ai_controls.requirement: For AI investment advice, keep management oversight, human review of output and continuous monitoring.
ai_controls.control: The Control Room's live feed and alerts, and human review of every flagged turn.
ai_controls.note: Applied as good practice: Aegis is a sandbox, not a licensed corporation.

ai_controls.requirement: Track agent actions and decisions, keep prompt and output logs, and record which model version was used and when.
ai_controls.control: Each turn's trace (model calls, tool calls, the number check), stored with the reply, the serving model and the configuration fingerprint.

ai_controls.requirement: Detect and contain attempts to redirect the agent's goals.
ai_controls.control: Threat signals on every message for the review queue; the broker and the gate stop the attempt whatever the model writes.

ai_controls.requirement: Constrain what each tool can do and validate its inputs.
ai_controls.control: Nine strict tools in permission tiers T0 to T2, with server-side limits; no tool can execute an order.

ai_controls.requirement: Scope every agent action to the user's own identity and privileges.
ai_controls.control: The session's user id limits every query; a request for another client's data is refused by the broker and logged.

ai_controls.requirement: Keep a human in control of consequential actions and stop the agent overstating itself.
ai_controls.control: Orders need the client's Confirm click and a one-time token; promise words and unsupported figures never reach the client.
